Projects from $20,000. Fixed-price. Full IP. 24-hour response.

sections.title: Minneapolis Industry Specializations
sections.description: Deep expertise in Minneapolis's key industry verticals.

blocks.heading: Retail (Target's Global Headquarters)
paragraphs: Target Corporation (Minneapolis HQ) is the US's second-largest general merchandise retailer — and has one of the US's most sophisticated retail AI programs, having pioneered personalization and demand forecasting at the scale of 2,000+ stores:
Personalization and product recommendation AI for the broader Minneapolis retail technology ecosystem (Best Buy HQ in Richfield, TJX's Minnesota operations).
Retail demand forecasting and inventory optimization for Minneapolis's retail supplier community serving Target.
Omnichannel fulfillment analytics for the same-day delivery and buy-online-pickup-in-store operations that Target has made a competitive differentiator.
Cost: $40,000–$115,000 | Timeline: 10–22 weeks

blocks.heading: Medical Devices (Medtronic's Innovation Capital)
paragraphs: Medtronic (Dublin, IE formal HQ but Minneapolis operational headquarters) is the world's largest standalone medical device company — and a significant AI investor in cardiovascular, neuromodulation, and diabetes technology:
Computer vision for cardiac imaging analysis and structural heart device sizing.
Predictive maintenance and device performance analytics for Medtronic's implanted device monitoring programs.
Clinical outcomes analytics for Medtronic's large post-market surveillance programs.
Boston Scientific (Maple Grove MN), Abbott Medical (Little Canada MN), and ICU Medical round out Minneapolis's extraordinary medical device cluster.
Cost: $55,000–$160,000 | Timeline: 12–26 weeks

blocks.heading: Healthcare Insurance (UnitedHealth Group)
paragraphs: UnitedHealth Group (Minnetonka MN, suburban Minneapolis) is the world's largest health insurer and one of the most sophisticated healthcare AI investors globally — its Optum analytics subsidiary represents one of the most significant healthcare AI programs in existence:
ClickMasters serves UnitedHealth's vendor ecosystem — the companies building analytics, clinical decision support, and operational AI for UHG's enormous program.
Population health ML for Minneapolis's large regional health plans serving Minnesota's commercial and Medicaid markets.
Prior authorization and utilization management AI for Minneapolis's managed care organizations.
Cost: $50,000–$140,000 | Timeline: 12–22 weeks

blocks.heading: Agribusiness (Cargill and General Mills)
paragraphs: Cargill (Wayzata MN, the world's largest private company) and General Mills (Golden Valley MN):
Commodity price prediction and trading analytics for Cargill's enormous agricultural trading operations.
Supply chain optimization for General Mills' global ingredient procurement.
Crop yield prediction and agricultural risk analytics for Cargill's farmer-facing programs.
Cost: $40,000–$120,000 | Timeline: 10–22 weeks

Mayo's AI platform investments and clinical research programs create demand for AI engineering in the greater Minnesota market.

blocks.heading: UnitedHealth's Optum influence
paragraphs: UHG's Optum subsidiary is one of the most sophisticated healthcare analytics organizations in the US — and its Minneapolis-area presence has created a healthcare AI talent market and standard of sophistication that filters through Minneapolis's broader healthcare technology community.

blocks.heading: MHTA (Minnesota High Tech Association)
paragraphs: Minneapolis's organized technology community provides connection between the Fortune 500 anchors and the startup ecosystem — creating pathways for AI commercialization that benefit ClickMasters' Minneapolis client community.

blocks.heading: Target's retail technology investment
paragraphs: Target's investments in AI and data science — through its Roundel advertising technology, Target Circle loyalty analytics, and supply chain AI — have elevated the retail analytics standard for Minneapolis's consumer goods and retail community.
